notes.title: Want to SLEEPOVER?
notes.content:
Hello Friends and Family...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34247617/d6cdef236829d981bea400ac868784a373c077f3.png[/img]

SLEEPOVER: Slasher's Home is nearing the end of it's Early Access stage on Steam, and quickly approaching the dawn of 1.0


Below is some of the recent major changes made to the game, providing some idea of what's to come.
[list]
[*] Now in Third Person
[*] Homeowner now has Flashlight
[*] Slasher speed increased
[*] Slasher can Sprint now, though with Stamina drain
[*] Homeowner can find and equip single-use weapons around the house (knifes get stuck in Slasher for example)
[*] Slasher AI added for Singleplayer (players can seamlessly join and take control of AI Slashers)
[*] Player queue and spectator system added so more than 2 players can be in one lobby, and the winner plays the Homeowner 
[*] Main Menu now features Feedback/Help button that links to bug report form
[/list]

More to come in the future. If you would like to check out livestream development of the game visit the Twitch channel for JarthGames.


Yours truly,
JarthGames
